config.note: LOCO-CAV-MARCH: the re-authored MARCH measured natively (no provider), held at the MARCH phase the cavalry pivot provider admits (7/16). Not a certificate: the native PIVOT clips are source fixtures that no MARCH pose meets, so the pivots fail here; the provider (LOCO-CAV-PROVIDER) replaces them.

consumer_requirements.rule: stop, start and hold only at these MARCH phases; a MARCH hold resumes at the phase it holds

digest_rule: sha256 of canonical JSON (sorted keys, no spaces) of every field except payload_sha256, digest_rule and locomotion_certificate

planting_band.rule: per foot: b_f = max(0.5 mm, H_f + 0.5 mm); H_f = highest of the foot's per-stance minimum sole heights, stances = runs among the lower half of the feet; a vertex belongs to the foot whose bone carries its largest skin weight (ties: lower bone index); vertices of no foot are never planted

skin.rule: length > 4 x native-entry AND > 0.03 model m; fails unless the native seek at the same phase is flagged

visual_review: PENDING: R-C requires the real-window review after this numeric pass
